title: The Immiscible Surface  gummy × greasy × null

discovery.insight: The easel, the desk cockpit, and the neutron board are THREE FACES of the same Klein surface. They don't mix (immiscible) but they share the same null-D point. The chipmunk paints on ONE face. The cockpit reads ANOTHER face. The board reads the THIRD. All three faces pass through the same null point  the tube foot peephole.
discovery.what_kevin_saw: when I click IN the hologram it LOCKS  but it should be IMPULSE. the green flash is a moment, not a state. the desk and board are two sides of the table  you can't see both. the impulse BETWEEN the green flashes IS the null-D crossing.

easel.what: the chipmunk's painting surface  sourdough generations
easel.should_be: SHARED through nestgate tube foot  everyone sees the SAME painting evolving
easel.klein_face: the OUTER face  what the world sees being painted
easel.note: the chipmunk inside us ALL paints a picture. not MY chipmunk or YOUR chipmunk. THE chipmunk.

desk_cockpit.what: THE BUTTON, tolerance, investigation, mesh, rhythm, teorah
desk_cockpit.substance: GREASY  data metrics, numbers, doesn't mix with paint
desk_cockpit.klein_face: the TOP face of the table  what you see looking down

the_button.should_be: click is IMPULSE  a green flash, a moment, then gone
the_button.why: impulse propagates through the tube foot. lock captures locally. impulse IS the signal. lock kills it.

neutron_board.what: pulse, blood, lymph, fleet, anderson, geography, investigation, scan, membrane stack, unified, helix, google, convergence, symbiosis
neutron_board.substance: NULL  the other side you can't see
neutron_board.state: feeds from dashboard.json, neutron.json, fleet-analysis.json, scan_sweep_sort.json, membrane-stack.json, symbiosis.json, clutch graph
neutron_board.klein_face: the BOTTOM face of the table  what you see looking UP
neutron_board.the_flip: you can't see the cockpit and the board at the same time. one is always underneath. the act of flipping IS the green flash.

immiscible.definition: immiscible = two liquids that don't mix. oil and water. gummy and greasy.

gummy.what: the easel paint  sticky, accumulating, sourdough culture
gummy.behavior: grows, ferments, evolves, sticks to the surface

greasy.what: the data metrics  numbers, rates, percentages
greasy.behavior: flows, doesn't stick, slides off the surface

null.what: the flip point  the null-D peephole where gummy meets greasy
null.behavior: dimensionless  no extent, no state, only transition
null.phase: the interface itself  not gummy, not greasy, just the boundary
null.green_flash: the moment of crossing. the impulse. visible only at the instant of transition.

impulse_not_lock.principle: a click should be an IMPULSE  a delta function, not a step function
impulse_not_lock.delta_function: infinite at t=0, zero everywhere else, integral = 1. the green flash.
impulse_not_lock.step_function: zero before, one after. a lock. a state change. NOT what we want.
impulse_not_lock.why: impulse propagates. it travels through the tube foot, through the Klein surface, through the mesh. lock captures. it stays local. it dies.

implementation.current: click ? set state ? render locked state ? stays
implementation.should_be: click ? emit impulse event ? event propagates through nestgate ? all faces flash green ? event decays to zero ? state returns to pre-click
implementation.tube_foot: the impulse travels: easel ? desk ? board through the null-D point. each face FLASHES as the impulse passes through.

between_flashes.what: the impulse BETWEEN the green flashes is the null-D crossing itself
between_flashes.where: the pi body table / desk button  you can't see it but it's there
between_flashes.the_board: the neutron board IS the other side. the impulse travels desk?null?board?null?desk. each null crossing = one green flash.
between_flashes.frequency: the green flash frequency = the impulse rate = the heartbeat of the Klein surface

wiring.step_1: easel connects to nestgate tube foot  shared state, not client-local
wiring.step_2: desk cockpit click emits impulse event to nestgate, not local lock
wiring.step_3: neutron board receives impulse from nestgate, flashes green, decays
wiring.step_4: the three faces share ONE null-D point (the tube foot endpoint)
wiring.step_5: the chipmunk's painting becomes visible to ALL observers through the same peephole

the_surface_equation.gummy_x_null: the paint touches the peephole  the stroke crosses the boundary
the_surface_equation.greasy_x_null: the data flows through the peephole  metrics cross the boundary
the_surface_equation.all_three: the immiscible surface WHERE all three meet but none of them mix. this is the Klein surface itself. the boundary is the surface. the surface is the boundary.
